name: wedding-motion-studio
description: 結婚式ムービー用モーション素材生成スタジオ (Remotion)

scripts.check:start-wedding-edit-v2: pnpm typecheck && pnpm sync:start-wedding-edit-local && pnpm check:start-wedding-edit-phrase-qa && (test -d out/start-wedding-edit-review-v3 && pnpm check:start-wedding-edit-contrast-qa || echo 'skip: out/start-wedding-edit-review-v3が無いためcontrast QAは未実行。pnpm render:start-wedding-edit:review-v3 実行後に pnpm check:start-wedding-edit-contrast-qa を実行すること。')
scripts.render:start-129:final: pnpm check:start-129-final-gate && pnpm prepare:start-129 && node --no-warnings scripts/render-start-129-all.mts --final
scripts.render:start-129:a: pnpm prepare:start-129 && remotion render src/index-start-129.ts Start129-A-Clean out/start-129/start_129_a_clean.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=28
scripts.render:start-129:b: pnpm prepare:start-129 && remotion render src/index-start-129.ts Start129-B-Clean out/start-129/start_129_b_clean.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=28
scripts.render:start-129:c: pnpm prepare:start-129 && remotion render src/index-start-129.ts Start129-C-Clean out/start-129/start_129_c_clean.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=28
scripts.render:start-129:all-preview: pnpm render:start-129:a && pnpm render:start-129:b && pnpm render:start-129:c
scripts.prepare:opening-v1: pnpm sync:photos && pnpm check:opening-photos && pnpm opening:preflight
scripts.render:opening-v1: pnpm prepare:opening-v1 && pnpm check:opening-photos:strict && pnpm check:opening-sound:strict && remotion render src/index-opening-v1.ts OpeningV1 out/opening/opening_v1.mp4 && pnpm check:opening-render
scripts.render:opening-v1:preview: pnpm prepare:opening-v1 && remotion render src/index-opening-v1.ts OpeningV1 out/preview/opening_v1_preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=24
scripts.check: pnpm check:motion && pnpm check:assets && pnpm check:parts && pnpm check:presets && pnpm check:start-motion-kit && pnpm check:director-recipes && pnpm check:director-visual-fidelity && pnpm check:start-section-recipes && pnpm check:start-extended-rough && pnpm check:claude-codex-ab && pnpm check:start-129 && pnpm check:start-129-media && pnpm check:start-129-storyboard
scripts.render:stamp-test: remotion render 透過確認-押印 out/common/stamp_test_vp9.webm --codec=vp9 --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva420p
scripts.render:stamp-test:prores: remotion render 透過確認-押印 out/common/stamp_test_prores.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva444p10le
scripts.render:stamp-test:preview: remotion render 透過確認-紙背景 out/common/stamp_test_preview.mp4

scripts.render:stamp:okinawa:prores: remotion render 押印-沖縄 out/opening/stamp_okinawa.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva444p10le

scripts.render:window: remotion render 飛行機窓 out/opening/airplane_window.mp4
